title: Phased deployment field notes
content:
Quick context / intent:
- Small, informal run-book for tomorrow's phased release of v2.11.0 to hosted inference. Personal checklist + scribbles for on-call handoff. Keep it tight — I want to be able to hand to SRE and go.

Goals / success criteria:
- Validate end-to-end correctness for a representative 90% of requests (structured outputs) without impacting p95 latency by >10% compared to baseline.
- No customer-facing errors > 0.5% sustained for 10 minutes.
- No regressions on embed similarity tests (synthetic prompts).

Quick release plan (phased traffic shaping):
- 00:00 — deploy canary instances (2 pods, region: us-west1, config: cpu-bound + int8 quant profile)
- 00:10 — sanity checks and smoke traffic (10 users, automated) -> internal tests only
- 00:25 — open to 1% of traffic (global, routed by cookie) for 30m
- 01:00 — if OK, ramp 1% -> 5% for 45m
- 02:00 — ramp 5% -> 20% for 1h (keep edge region at 5%)
- 03:30 — if stable, ramp to 50% for 30m then 100% if all gates pass

Notes on traffic split method:
- Use routing policy: cookie-based sticky split via traffic-proxy (route key = release_v2_11).
- Edge fallback: set header X-RW-Fallback=true to map to stable model when latency SLO breaches.
- Important: keep a small persistent seed (0.5%) pinned to old model for comparison & alerting.

Preflight checks (must pass before 00:25):
- health endpoints for all canary pods return 200 within 250ms
- KV cache warmup completed: check cache-hit ratio >= 70% after synthetic warmup run
- token-per-request distribution looks consistent with baseline (run quick token histogram)
- synthetic eval set (100 prompts) returns expected structured fields, allow 1 soft-fail
- tracing: startspan tag includes release=canary_v2_11
- cost/per-token estimate validated against sample load (spot-check)

Observability dashboard / queries to watch (live):
- latency:
  - p50/p95/p99 generation latency by model+region (grafana panel)
  - distribution of first-byte time (for streaming paths)
- errors:
  - 4xx/5xx rate per route, 10m rolling window
  - malformed JSON or schema validation failures metric (counts)
- quality:
  - embed-similarity drop: run daily job for 100 anchors, alert if avg sim drops by > 0.02 vs baseline
- cost:
  - tokens / second and tokens-per-request (to detect runaway prompts)

Alert thresholds (temporary for this rollout):
- error rate > 0.5% for 10m -> page on-call
- p95 latency increase > 20% vs baseline for 15m -> automatic partial rollback to pinned variant
- schema-failure count > 5 in 5m -> immediate rollback and investigation

Rollback and fallback procedures (fast path):
- immediate fallback: toggle routing policy to send traffic to stable model (route key = stable_v2_10), leave canary pods running for debugging
- full rollback: deploy pin to stable containers via infra action (infra CLI):
  - infra release pin set --env=hosted --model stable_v2_10 --duration=24h --reason="auto-rollback"
- post-rollback: collect and upload traces for last 30m, run synthetic test suite and attach results to JIRA INF-1294

Pinning notes (manual pins to keep):
- Keep 0.5% global pinned to stable for comparison (label: pinned-stable-0_5)
- Add per-customer pins for top-5 paying accounts during rollout window (check legal approvals first)

Commands & quick snippets (for on-call):
- show canary pods: kubectl -n hosted get pods -l release=canary_v2_11 -o wide
- tail logs: kubectl -n hosted logs -f deployment/canary-v2-11 --since=10m | jq .message
- toggle routing (test toggle): curl -X POST "$TRAFFIC_API/toggle" -d '{"route":"release_v2_11","pct":1}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
- pin stable: infra release pin set --env=hosted --model stable_v2_10 --duration=24h --reason "safety-pin"

Synthetic prompts to run during canary (quick set):
- 10 short chat queries for latency (<= 15 tokens)
- 20 mid-length generation requests (100-400 tokens), some with tool-calling disabled
- 30 structured-output tasks: validate fields and types (the main risk vector)
- 20 embedding pairs for similarity sanity (anchor vs paraphrase)

Open questions / TODOs for follow-up (notes to self):
- Do we want a second canary region (europe) or keep single-region to reduce blast radius? Pros/cons doc link?
- Need a clear list of customers to exclude from routing (legal asks). Who owns that list?
- Confirm that cost-metering tags are active for this release (tags: release=v2_11). Miguel to verify infra tagging.
- Add a quick opt-out endpoint for customers to opt out of canary without CS ticket (tech debt).

Post-rollout checklist (if final rollout):
- Increase autoscale min pods to match demand profile for new model if needed
- Run full regressions (1k synthetic prompts) overnight and upload report
- Update release notes with known limitations and observed behavior
- Remove temporary alerts and restore normal thresholds
- Schedule retro with SRE + runtime next week (30m)

Random notes / heuristics I keep forgetting:
- If p95 spikes but error rate stays low, check queue length and KV cache hit — sometimes slowdowns come from cache churn not from model slowness
- Keep an eye for token blowouts: a small number of clients can drive cost; watch tokens-per-request percentile 99.9
- Use span traces tagged with "compare_to=stable" when pinned seed is enabled to simplify diffs

Hand-off summary (one-liner for on-call):
- "Canary v2.11 up in us-west1. Ramp to 1% after smoke. Watch p95, error rate, and structured-schema failures. Page if error >0.5% or p95 >20% above baseline. Automatic fallback exists; manual rollback command in infra CLI."

End of notes. Will convert to a slightly cleaner runbook after the rollout is stable.

-- L.K.
